provenance.solver/bed_temperature_bracket: T_amb+10 K; fallback [T_amb+0.5 K, T_amb+10 K] iff the residual at T_amb+10 K is negative

ambient_annual_mean_celsius.source: long-term annual mean of the air temperature in Germany, order of magnitude

ambient_relative_humidity.source: as storage test 1 (docs/19), annual mean order of magnitude

normal_density_kg_per_nm3.source: dry air at 0 degC, 1.01325 bar (definition); volumes read as Nm3/h
normal_density_kg_per_nm3.status: placeholder (the reading m3/h = Nm3/h is an assumption)

plant_a_air_nm3_per_h.source: partner, order of magnitude (about 30 000 m3/h process air)

plant_a_heat_supply_efficiency.source: steam heater: gas boiler (about 0.90-0.95) times steam distribution losses; typical literature range

plant_c_inlet_celsius.source: no partner figure; same process as plant A assumed (as docs/19)

plant_c_burner_efficiency.source: direct-fired gas burner: the flue gas enters the process air, only radiation and casing losses; typical manufacturer range

plant_c_hours_volume_reading.source: volume reading: lines run at the stated flow all year (planned plant)

plant_c_reading_factor.source: Befund 99: exhaust of plant C by volume flow is 4.9 times the partner's annual figure (999 against 205 kW mean); annual reading = volume reading / 4.9
plant_c_reading_factor.status: derived (contradiction of the partner data, both readings carried)

co2_price_eur_per_t.source: partner (55 EUR/t now, 300 EUR/t assumed for 2030)

exhaust_temperatures_celsius.source: 34.4 and 60.7: measured exhaust outlet of plant A on the two days of docs/19 (product 2 / product 1); 45: middle placeholder

humidity_pickup_kg_per_kg.source: evaporated water per kg dry air of a spray granulator; no plant figure (the exhaust humidity of plant A is reconstructed, docs/19)

exhaust_relative_humidity_limit.source: a design limit of the exhaust relative humidity (product moisture, condensation in ducts and filter); no partner figure

transfer.note: transfer of LAB saving fractions to partner orders of magnitude; no plant model
